spec.rule: Require 3s net movement and the latest quote step to agree with continuation. Equality on the latest step is permitted; zero 3s net move is not. No fixed wait or new timer. Existing 3s/2500ms range-turn constants are reused, not outcome fitted.
spec.selection: Only the final-origin impulse reason is gated in the narrow variant. The base variant changes the original continuation admission; other routes still use their existing evidence.
spec.holdout: 09/12/15/18 UTC windows registered before implementation and before their baseline/candidate results were inspected; all are on the same external trading day.
caveats: Public external Forex ticks are not the user broker/OTC session or settlements.
Known video has no native OHLC and is already used in development.
Synthetic paths are behavior stress tests, not accuracy estimates.

limitations: External Dukascopy Forex data, not IQ Option/Exnova OTC and not the user session.
1m OHLC aggregated from the source ticks, not broker-supplied native candles.
No interpolation or invented ticks; evaluate on actual quoted prices and timestamps.
